title: A dilation-invariant set that is locally H^m-finite away from the origin is H^m-finite on compact sets (parent step 6)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ with m ≥ 1 and M ⊆ ℝ^P. Assume: 0 ∉ M; closure M ⊆ M ∪ {0}; tx ∈ M for all t > 0 and x ∈ M; and every y ∈ M has an open B ∋ y with H^m(M ∩ B) < ∞ (H^m = μHE[m]). Then H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ m → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ M → closure M ⊆ insert 0 M → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ M, t • x ∈ M) → (∀ y ∈ M, ∃ B : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen B ∧ y ∈ B ∧ μHE[m] (M ∩ B) ≠ ∞) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞
